mapper.sql: C.CUST_ID, C.CUST_NM, C.CUST_GRADE, U.USER_NM AS CHARGE_USER_NM, O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_DT, O.ORDER_AMT, O.ORDER_STATUS, P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NM, OI.QTY, OI.AMT AS ITEM_AMT, B.BILL_ID, B.TOTAL_AMT AS BILL_AMT, IFNULL(CL.COLLECT_AMT, 0) AS COLLECT_AMT

FROM TB_CUSTOMER C INNER JOIN TB_ORDER O ON O.CUST_ID = C.CUST_ID INNER JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID INNER JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = C.CHARGE_USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BILL B ON B.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_COLLECT CL ON CL.BILL_ID = B.BILL_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY O.ORDER_DT DESC, C.CUST_NM, P.PRODUCT_NM

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(O.ORDER_DT, '%Y-%m') AS ORDER_YM, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_CNT, SUM(O.ORDER_AMT) AS ORDER_AMT FROM TB_ORDER O WHERE O.ORDER_DT BETWEEN #{fromDt} AND #{toDt} AND O.ORDER_STATUS != '취소' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(O.ORDER_DT, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ORDER_YM

SELECT C.CUST_ID, C.CUST_NM, SUM(O.ORDER_AMT) AS ORDER_AMT FROM TB_CUSTOMER C INNER JOIN TB_ORDER O ON O.CUST_ID = C.CUST_ID WHERE O.ORDER_DT BETWEEN #{fromDt} AND #{toDt} AND O.ORDER_STATUS != '취소' GROUP BY C.CUST_ID, C.CUST_NM ORDER BY ORDER_AMT DESC LIMIT #{topN}

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NM, SUM(OI.QTY) AS QTY, SUM(OI.AMT) AS ITEM_AMT FROM TB_ORDER_ITEM OI INNER JOIN TB_PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID INNER JOIN TB_ORDER O ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_DT BETWEEN #{fromDt} AND #{toDt} AND O.ORDER_STATUS != '취소' GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NM ORDER BY ITEM_AMT DESC
